sentences.en: LIZZIE: So how are you getting on with your teaching practice at the High School, Joe?
sentences.zh: LIZZIE: 那么，乔，你在高中的教学实习进展得怎么样？

sentences.en: JOE: Well I've been put in charge of the school marching band, and it's quite a responsibility.
sentences.zh: JOE: 嗯，我被委任负责学校的行进乐队，这可是个不小的担子。

sentences.en: I'd like to talk it over with you.
sentences.zh: 我想和你一起讨论一下。

sentences.en: LIZZIE: Go ahead.
sentences.zh: LIZZIE: 请讲。

sentences.en: You'd better start by giving me a bit of background.
sentences.zh: 你最好先给我简单介绍一下背景情况。

sentences.en: JOE: OK.
sentences.zh: JOE: 好的。

sentences.en: Well the band has students in it from all years, so they're aged 11 to 18, and there are about 50 of them altogether.
sentences.zh: 嗯，乐队里有来自各个年级的学生，年龄在11到18岁之间，总共有大约50人。

sentences.en: It's quite a popular activity within the school.
sentences.zh: 这是学校里一项颇受欢迎的活动。

sentences.en: I've never worked with a band of more than 20 before, and this is very different.
sentences.zh: 我以前从未带过超过20人的乐队，这次的情况非常不同。

sentences.en: LIZZIE: can imagine.
sentences.zh: LIZZIE: 我能想象。

sentences.en: JOE: They aren't really good enough to enter national band competitions, but they're in regional one later in the term.
sentences.zh: JOE: 他们的水平还不足以参加全国性的乐队比赛，但本学期晚些时候会参加一场地区性比赛。

sentences.en: Even if they don't win, and I don't expect them to, hopefully it'll be an incentive for them to try and improve.
sentences.zh: 即便他们没能获胜——而我也不指望他们能赢——但希望这能激励他们努力提升自己。

sentences.en: LIZZIE: Yes, hopefully.
sentences.zh: LIZZIE: 是啊，但愿如此。

sentences.en: JOE: Well, now the town council's organising a carnival in the summer, and the band has been asked to perform.
sentences.zh: JOE: 嗯，现在市议会正在筹备夏季狂欢节，乐队受邀进行表演。

sentences.en: If you ask me, they aren't really up to it yet, and need to get them functioning better as a band, and in a very short time.
sentences.zh: 依我看，他们目前还远未达到演出要求，亟需在极短时间内提升整个乐队的协作水平。

sentences.en: LIZZIE.
sentences.zh: LIZZIE:

sentences.en: Have you been doing anything with them?
sentences.zh: 你有没有带他们做过些什么？

sentences.en: Apart from practising the music, mean.
sentences.zh: 除了排练乐曲之外，我的意思是。

sentences.en: JOE: played a recording | came across, of a drummer talking about how playing in a band had changed his life.
sentences.zh: JOE: 我播放了一段偶然发现的录音，是一位鼓手讲述加入乐队如何改变了他的人生。

sentences.en: I think it was an after-dinner speech. thought it was pretty inspiring, because being in the band had stopped him from getting involved in crime.
sentences.zh: 我想那是一场饭后演讲。我觉得挺鼓舞人心的，因为加入乐队使他避免了卷入犯罪。

sentences.en: The students seemed to find it interesting, too.
sentences.zh: 学生们似乎也觉得很有意思。

sentences.en: LIZZIE: That's good.
sentences.zh: LIZZIE: 那很好。

sentences.en: JOE: I'm planning to show them that old film from the 1940s 'Strike Up the Band, and talk about it with the students.
sentences.zh: JOE: 我打算给学生们放映那部20世纪40年代的老电影《奏响乐队》（Strike Up the Band），并和他们一起讨论。

sentences.en: What do you think?
sentences.zh: 你觉得怎么样？

sentences.en: LIZZIE: Good idea.
sentences.zh: LIZZIE: 主意不错。

sentences.en: As it's about a school band, it might make it the students realise how much they can achieve if they work together.
sentences.zh: 既然讲的是学校乐队，或许能让学生们意识到：只要齐心协力，他们就能取得多大的成就。

sentences.en: JOE: That's what I've got in mind.
sentences.zh: JOE: 这正是我的想法。

sentences.en: I'm hoping | can take some of the band a to a parade that's going to take place next month.
sentences.zh: 我希望下个月能带乐队中的一部分成员去观看一场游行。

sentences.en: A couple of marching bands will be performing, and the atmosphere should be quite exciting.
sentences.zh: 届时将有几支行进乐队进行表演，现场气氛应该相当热烈。

sentences.en: It depends on whether I can persuade the school to hire a coach or two to take us there.
sentences.zh: 这取决于我能否说服学校租用一两辆大巴送我们过去。

sentences.en: LIZZIE: Mmm.
sentences.zh: LIZZIE: 嗯。

sentences.en: They sound like good ideas to me.
sentences.zh: 这些主意听起来都挺不错的。

sentences.en: JOE: Thanks.
sentences.zh: JOE: 谢谢。

sentences.en: JOE: Can I tell you about a few people in the band who I'm finding it quite difficult to cope with?
sentences.zh: JOE: 我可以跟你讲讲乐队里几个让我感到很难应对的人吗？

sentences.en: I'm sure you'll have some ideas about what I can do.
sentences.zh: 我相信你一定能给我一些应对建议。

sentences.en: LIZZIE: Go ahead.
sentences.zh: LIZZIE: 请讲。

sentences.en: JOE: There's a flautist who says she loves playing in the band.
sentences.zh: JOE: 有一位长笛手，她说自己特别喜欢在乐队里演奏。

sentences.en: We rehearse twice a week after school, but she's hardly ever there.
sentences.zh: 我们每周放学后排练两次，但她几乎从不参加。

sentences.en: Then she looks for me the next day and gives me a very plausible reason - she says she had to help her mother, or she's been ill, but to be honest, I don't believe her.
sentences.zh: 然后第二天她就来找我，给出一个非常可信的理由——比如她说要帮妈妈做事，或者生病了；但说实话，我并不相信她。

sentences.en: LIZZIE: Oh dear!
sentences.zh: LIZZIE: 哎呀！

sentences.en: Any more students with difficulties?
sentences.zh: 还有其他学生遇到困难吗？

sentences.en: JOE: Plenty!
sentences.zh: JOE: 多得很！

sentences.en: There's a trumpeter who thinks she's the best musician in the band, though she certainly isn't.
sentences.zh: 有个吹小号的女生自认为是乐队里最出色的音乐家，尽管她显然并非如此。

sentences.en: She's always saying what she thinks other people.
sentences.zh: 她总是对别人该做什么指手画脚。

sentences.en: should do, which makes my job pretty difficult.
sentences.zh: 这让我工作起来相当困难。

sentences.zh: ,.-CERX

sentences.en: LIZZIE: She sounds a bit of a nightmare!
sentences.zh: LIZZIE: 她听起来简直是个噩梦！

sentences.en: WARIELTSY
sentences.zh: WARIELTSY

sentences.en: JOE: You can say that again.
sentences.zh: JOE: 你这话可真说对了。

sentences.en: One of the trombonists has got an impressive sense of rhythm, and could be an excellent musician - except that he has breathing difficulties, and he doesn't really have enough breath for the trombone.
sentences.zh: 其中一位长号手节奏感非常出色，本可以成为一位优秀的音乐家——可惜他有呼吸困难的问题，肺活量根本不足以支撑长号演奏。

sentences.en: He'd be much better off playing percussion, for instance, but he refuses to give up.
sentences.zh: 他其实更适合演奏打击乐器之类，但他却拒绝放弃长号。

sentences.en: So he ends up only playing half the notes.
sentences.zh: 结果他最终只能奏出一半的音符。

sentences.en: LIZZIE: suppose you have to admire his determination.
sentences.zh: LIZZIE: 我想你不得不钦佩他的决心。

sentences.en: JOE: Maybe.
sentences.zh: JOE: 也许吧。

sentences.en: One of the percussionists isn't too bad, but he never seems to interact with other people, and he always rushes off as soon as the rehearsal ends.
sentences.zh: 还有一位打击乐手水平倒还不差，但他似乎从不与他人互动，每次排练一结束就立刻匆匆离开。

sentences.en: I don't know if there are family reasons, or what.
sentences.zh: 我不知道是不是家庭方面的原因，还是别的什么。

sentences.en: But it isn't good in a band, where people really need to feel they're part of a group.
sentences.zh: 但在一支乐队里，这种情况并不好，因为大家真的需要感受到自己是团队的一分子。

sentences.en: LIZZIE: Hmm.
sentences.zh: LIZZIE: 嗯。

sentences.en: JOE: There are others too, but at least that gives you an idea of what I'm up against.
sentences.zh: JOE: 还有其他人也存在问题，但至少这让你了解我目前面临的状况。

sentences.en: Do you have any thoughts about what I can do, Lizzie?
sentences.zh: Lizzie，你对我该怎么办有什么想法吗？
